subject: Next steps after today's discovery - Redwood x CloudBridge
messages:
From: Peter Liu <peter.liu@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps after today's discovery - Redwood x CloudBridge

Hi Marissa / Camila,

Thanks for walking us through Redwood today — appreciated the clear overview. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

- CloudBridge is evaluating a marketplace integration for our managed services customers; main goals are predictable latency for embeddings-driven search, fine-grained tenant isolation, and a private deployment option for regulated customers.
- Key stakeholders internally: me (platform partnerships), Alicia Park (security/compliance), and Rajesh Iyer (infra).

Can we schedule a technical deep dive / partner-led demo next week to cover architecture, API/marketplace flow, and SSO/KMS details? We have the following windows available (PT):

1) Wed, Oct 27 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
2) Thu, Oct 28 — 1:00–2:00 PM PT
3) Fri, Oct 29 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT

I attached CloudBridge's due-diligence checklist so you can see the items Alicia will flag. After the technical session we'll follow up with procurement and legal (DocuSign for the MAP).

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Peter Liu
Platform Partnerships | CloudBridge
_peter.liu@cloudbridge.com_

Attachment: CloudBridge-Due-Diligence-Reqs.pdf (PDF, 38KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Peter Liu <peter.liu@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after today's discovery - Redwood x CloudBridge

Hi Peter — thanks for the great session today and for sending the checklist. Recap + proposed next steps below.

Recap:
- Primary use case: marketplace integration for managed customers (search + embeddings, multi-tenant isolation).
- Top requirements: low tail latency for inference, support for private deployments/VPC, KMS integration for customer keys, SOC 2 evidence.

Proposed next steps:
1) Technical deep dive/demo with our SE to run through architecture, model routing, and KMS flow.
2) We'll provide a mutual action plan (MAP) and pricing summary ahead of procurement.
3) Security questionnaire and SOC 2 artifacts: Rafael will own the artifact bundle and Camila will coordinate timelines with your security team.

Availability — we can do any of the times you proposed. Rafael and I prefer Wed 10:00 AM PT if that works for your team. If not, Thu 1:00 PM PT is also okay.

I've attached a draft MAP and a short pricing summary for your review. If you confirm Wed 10:00 AM PT we'll send a calendar invite with a technical agenda and a Google Meet link.

Looking forward — thanks again.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachments:

- redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx (Excel, 9KB)
